definitions.explanation: Hokkaido dialect intensifier equivalent to standard Japanese とても or すごく.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧なまら⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ジンギスカン→ジンギスカン：30439_jingisukan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧なまら⟦うまい→うまい：01279_umai⟧。
examples.english: This Genghis Khan (lamb BBQ) is really delicious.

notes:
DIALECT:
Hokkaido (⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧) dialect, one of the most recognizable features of Hokkaido speech.

STANDARD EQUIVALENT:
⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧ / ⟦すごく→すごい：01128_sugoi⟧ / ⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (standard Japanese)

ETYMOLOGY:
Believed to derive from ⟦{生|なま}→生：03509_nama⟧ (raw, unprocessed), implying something in its pure, unmitigated form.

USAGE:
Very commonly used in everyday Hokkaido speech, especially among younger speakers. Has gained recognition nationwide through media.
なまら has become somewhat iconic of Hokkaido identity and is often used playfully by non-Hokkaido speakers when discussing the region.

OTHER HOKKAIDO DIALECT WORDS:
- しばれる - to be freezing cold
- ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦っけ→っけ：10739_kke⟧ - well then; goodbye
- めんこい - cute
- ⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|な}げる→投げる：01135_nageru⟧ - to throw away garbage
